$comment: Negative fixture for RFC-AITP-0005 §5.3. The token is a standard mint (`__JWS_TCT__`) signed by kat-keypair-002, the `iss`; `aud` equals `expected_audience`. The claims are schema-valid, so the map entry is `expect: valid`: the rejection is a verifier rule. `iss != sub` keeps the iss == sub rule (tct-015) from firing, and the marker is not the first or only grant, so only a full scan of `grants` catches it.
description: A TCT whose `grants` carries the `aitp.attestation` marker beside an ordinary grant MUST be rejected in a grant context with TCT_SIGNATURE_INVALID (RFC-AITP-0005 §5.3, "Marker grant"). agentB issues agentA a TCT with grants `["read_data", "aitp.attestation"]`. An issuer MUST NOT put the marker beside any other grant, and a verifier in a grant context MUST reject any TCT whose `grants` contains it. A verifier that only recognizes an attestation by `grants == ["aitp.attestation"]`, or that grants `read_data` and ignores the unknown marker, fails this fixture.

expected.rationale: RFC-AITP-0005 §5.3: a verifier in a grant context MUST reject any TCT whose `grants` contains `aitp.attestation`, whatever its position and whatever else is granted. The ordinary `read_data` grant is not authorized either: the whole token is rejected.
